evidence.claim: The app ownership guide and stored-rollout presentation/inspection surfaces were read, establishing the lightweight app route.
The Streamlit guidance, inventory implementation, app inventory usage, and focused tests were inspected.
A concrete existing contract and exact owners were identified: rollout inventory rows in inspection.py and the cached inventory/store selector in _stored_rollouts_page.py.
The checkout remained clean and no local rollout stores were discovered, supporting the reported operational count of zero and absence of provenance.
